messages.en:
{07 16 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I don't want to
talk to you right now, so
just go away, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma ei taha
praegu sinuga rääkida, nii
et mine ära, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Get away from me!{01 00 00 0a 00} I've had
enough of your nonsense
already, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Mine minust eemale!{01 00 00 0a 00} Mul on
su jamast juba
kõrini, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}Don't even bother opening
your mouth, because I don't
want to talk to you.
{07 15 00}Why would I? You just keep
repeating the same thing
over and over again!
messages.et:
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}Ära isegi vaevu suud
avama, sest ma ei taha
sinuga rääkida.
{07 15 00}Miks ma tahaksin? Sa kordad
kogu aeg sama asja
ikka ja jälle!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Don't you look at me
like that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 07 00}You've got that mischievous
look again, {04 1f 00}!
I hate that look!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ära vaata mind
niimoodi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 07 00}Sul on jälle see kelmikas
ilme, {04 1f 00}!
Ma vihkan seda ilmet!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Why do you keep bothering
me, {04 1f 00}?

{07 15 00}I hate it when people won't
just leave me alone!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Miks sa mind aina tüütad,
{04 1f 00}?

{07 15 00}Ma vihkan, kui inimesed ei
jäta mind rahule!
